lines.x: You can leave that paperwork, I handled it already. Any issues, Doctor?

I've noticed Rhodes Island's ops don't tend to hold back on strength or personality. But nobody clashes with anyone. They're all able to treat each other with respect. I don't know what to make of it, honestly.
Vigna invited me to see her perform live. She's got impressive guitar skills. I'm really looking forward to it.
No need for concern. Practice time and rest time are both fully blocked out on my schedule, and I've given myself plenty of leeway in my work hours. I'm never going to collapse.
As long as Rhodes Island is going to look after me, I owe it to your people to help you out.

The relationship between you and Amiya-san is a good influence on everyone else. Just one of those Rhodes things. The people here all think of each other as family. I'm just as honored to be able to contribute.
These honey biscuits Ceobe-san likes are good. It's hard to stop eating them.
I know everyone at Rhodes Island has their own troubles, but they all prop each other up through whatever they're going through. I really owe a lot to them, especially you, Doctor. I'm very thankful.
A boatloads of squads requested for me to help them out with things again. I'll work through each task one by one for everyone at Rhodes Island.
Hmm... Doctor, I see you're still working at it. Here, a chocolate panna cotta to keep you going.
Umiri Yahata. If you need anything, just ask.
I like the efficiency. I'm taking notes.
I'm just doing what I'm supposed to.
I'm happy that everyone at Rhodes Island has accepted me. Perhaps they might even be able to fulfill my wishes too, don't you think?
Got it.
You want me to lead? Understood.
Let's get going.
I expected this. Let's go.
Here.
Hmm? Need me?
In position.
Right on target.
Leave it to me.
This is easy.
Hrnph!
Excuse me.
Mission complete. Couldn't have done it without you all.
That was some nice leadership, Doctor.
That was a close call. We need more practice under our belt.
Let's hustle. We're not going to leave anyone behind.
So this is the area I can freely utilize? Where's the training room then?
Eh?
Yes. I'm here.
Arknights.
Doctor. Happy New Year. I'm looking forward to our new journey ahead.
Hello, Doctor. Want to head to training?
There you are. Doctor, happy birthday. Here's your cake and your present. I guarantee it'll be good. I've had that store's cake before.

You know. Little by little I've opened up, here at Rhodes Island. Now I can put my own thoughts out there without worrying what others think of me. I have the people of Rhodes Island to thank for that, as well as you. So thank you, Doctor.
